note: Timings are IOP's stated typical values. Journal-specific median decision times are on journal homepages (not fetched).

stages.notes: choose journal, check scope, run checklist, anonymise if double-anonymous
confirm on journal page; Preflight tool for Word files
possible rejection or transfer offer; 10 days to accept or decline a transfer
usually two reviewers; adjudicator if they disagree; extensions possible
provisional accept, minor/moderate/major revision, reject (resubmit possible), reject, transfer offer
point-by-point response; copyright form and permissions required

stages.timing: published about 1 week after corrections arrive

stages.notes: repository deposit usually after 12-month embargo; corrigendum process

key_facts.rejection_rate: most journals typically above 50% (IOP review page)
key_facts.resubmission: article rejected in same or substantially similar form generally not reconsidered by IOP primary journals
